text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: PAGER-4521 fired — sudden surge of 429s on /v1/generate (multiple tenants showing errors)

olivia: acked PAGER-4521, taking lead. moving to #incidents-bridge for voice.

pagerduty: PagerDuty: Incident assigned to olivia (primary oncall)

maya: CS ping: three customers reported elevated errors: ember-tech, pixelwave, nova.ai. they're reporting production impact.

devops: looking at ingress logs and limiter metrics. nginx shows 429 spike starting 18:03 UTC, ratecap-controller cpu jump at 18:01. limiter-02 restarted once at 18:05.

sanjay: quick diff of recent rollouts — found CI job "rate-params" applied change 17:57 UTC that lowered anonymous default burst from 400 -> 40. that would explain mass throttles.

olivia: ok, plan: temporary per-tenant bypass for affected orgs + revert CI change after mitigation. want to avoid full rollback unless necessary.

ops-lead: agree with targeted override. can we patch a higher burst for the three tenants while keeping enforcement global?

devops: yes. can apply per-tenant override via config endpoint or kubectl patch. testing patch on staging now.

sanjay: staging canary for ember-tech looks good — 429s drop to baseline within 30s. preparing hotfix for production.

devops: hotfix command (ran from infra bastion):
```
kubectl -n infra exec -it limiter-controller-0 -- /bin/sh -c 'curl -X PATCH -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d "{\"per_tenant_overrides\":{\"ember-tech\":{\"burst\":800,\"rate\":1200},\"pixelwave\":{\"burst\":700,\"rate\":1000},\"nova.ai\":{\"burst\":600,\"rate\":900}}}" http://127.0.0.1:8080/config'
```

maya: CS updating customers. ember-tech reports traffic resumed and workflows recovered. pixelwave confirms lower error rate.

incident-bot: PagerDuty: olivia acknowledged incident at 18:12 UTC

olivia: monitoring system metrics and app logs. will hold off on CI rollback until overrides are live and stable ~10m.

devops: overrides applied to production at 18:14 UTC. observed immediate drop in 429s for those tenants. global telemetry still showing elevated 429s for anonymous/public routes though — confirming scope of change.

customer-success: impact estimates: ember-tech ~8.4k failed requests, pixelwave ~2.1k, nova.ai ~1.0k. tickets created and tagged P1. legal looped in for SLA review.

ops-lead: follow-ups: (1) revert the accidental CI change that reduced anonymous burst, (2) add a validation test in the deploy pipeline to simulate 5k rps before applying rate changes, (3) add Slack alerts for configmap changes in infra namespace with two-person approval, (4) postmortem with timeline and action items.

sanjay: opened PR #4310 to revert and include an e2e perf check. adding a canary rollout strategy to future rate-params job.

devops: enabling extra monitoring: configmap change alert to #eng-ops and a GitOps gate that requires explicit ack for ratecap updates.

olivia: handing off to night-sre at 02:00 UTC. notes for handoff: mitigation = per-tenant overrides applied, PR #4310 in progress to revert CI change, customer impact logged in CS tickets, postmortem owner = sanjay, watchlist = limiter-controller cpu/queue, ingress 429 rate.

maya: CS will follow up with affected customers with timeline and mitigation summary.

incident-bot: Incident resolved: PagerDuty PAGER-4521 closed by olivia at 18:42 UTC — followups scheduled.

olivia: thanks everyone. will synthesize timeline and hand over evidence to sanjay for RCA. great quick turnaround. :fire_extinguisher:
